subject: Order Form SLA reconciliation — uptime floor, blackout windows & credits ladder
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@helixpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@helixpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: HelixPay redlines to MSA/order form — SLA ask

Mina,

Thanks for the call this morning. Elena and I reviewed the MSA + order form and attached a redline with the HelixPay asks (Helix_Redlines_MSA_v2.pdf). High level the procurement team pushed back on three items we need to resolve before procurement signs: 

- Uptime floor: Procurement wants 99.99% uptime (monthly) for the Core API endpoints.
- Credits ladder: They want a linear credit equal to the % downtime multiplied by one month of committed spend (they propose no cap).
- P1 response SLA: 30 minute acknowledgement and 2-hour remediation window.

We understand Redwood's operational model and that some of this may be difficult to accept verbatim. Can Mina or your legal ops team propose acceptable compromise language? We have a tight procurement window (need signoff by end of month).

Attachments: Helix_Redlines_MSA_v2.pdf (redlined MSA + order form)

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Procurement, HelixPay
samir@helixpay.com
+1 415-555-0183
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Rao <samir@helixpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: HelixPay redlines to MSA/order form — SLA ask

Samir — thanks for the redlines and for flagging the procurement timeline. I reviewed the PDF and summarized what I think are reasonable negotiation points below. I've looped in Marissa (legal) and Jonas (SRE / accounts ops) to align on language and evidence ask.

Quick take / proposed compromise:
- Uptime floor: Redwood can accept a 99.95% monthly uptime commitment for Core API endpoints, with a target of 99.98% for read-only endpoints. We cannot accept 99.99% given multi-region routing variability.
- Credits ladder: propose a capped credit ladder: credits accrue per month as a % of monthly bill, up to a max of 50% of that month’s subscription charge. Language: "Service credits shall be calculated as X% of monthly fees for each defined uptime slab, not to exceed fifty percent (50%) of monthly fees for the affected month."
- P1 response SLA: we can tighten acknowledgement to 1 hour and initial remediation ETA within 4 hours. For critical production-impacting incidents that meet P1 criteria, we will provide a dedicated war-room and twice-daily updates until resolution.
- Maintenance windows / blackout: we will agree to a single quarterly blackout window for major platform changes (no more than 4 hours). Routine maintenance will be scheduled and communicated with 72 hours notice; HelixPay can request blackout dates in writing and we will exclude them where operationally feasible.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa will draft redline language for the MSA and order form (we'll attach as a marked-up document).
2) Jonas: can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a monthly uptime report (token-level breakdown) and what evidence we can include?
3) Samir / Elena: if you can confirm willingness to accept a capped credit model and the P1 compromise we can move quickly to a consolidated redline.

I realize procurement timeline is short — we will prioritize. Can we aim for a consolidated draft by EOD Tuesday (11/23)? If that works for you we will also calendar a 30 minute call to walk through the changes.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: HelixPay redlines to MSA/order form — SLA ask

Team — attaching a short suggested redline bundle (redline_suggested_ms_changes.docx) that implements Mina's compromise language. Key legal notes:

- Uptime metric: define "Core API endpoints" explicitly (add appendix with endpoint list) and define measurement methodology (monthly rolling window UTC).
- Credits: use the capped ladder Mina proposed. Add an exceptions section for scheduled maintenance and force majeure.
- Response times: split "acknowledgement" vs "initial remediation"; avoid hard remediation promises tied to specific fix times (use "work to begin within" language and require good-faith effort/war-room clause).
- Evidence & audit: require Redwood to provide monthly uptime reports and allow HelixPay a single annual third-party audit right (reasonable scope).

I'll include fallback wording if procurement insists on 99.99 — proposed language to add: "If customer (HelixPay) demonstrates material loss directly attributable to proven Redwood downtime beyond 99.98% for two consecutive months, the parties will meet to discuss additional remedies up to and including negotiated credits on a case-by-case basis." This preserves negotiation leverage while protecting Redwood.

I'll prepare the consolidated MSA + Order Form redline and send to Samir/Elena by EOD Tuesday as Mina suggested.

Marissa Cole
Counsel, Contracts & Commercial, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
From: Samir Rao <samir@helixpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@helixpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: HelixPay redlines to MSA/order form — SLA ask

Mina / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the proposed compromise. We reviewed the bullet points internally and we are prepared to move toward agreement if Redwood will accept the following two asks in addition to the compromise language:

1) Escalation playbook: HelixPay needs a 24/7 P1 on-call contact with defined escalation steps to an executive on-call if an incident is not acknowledged within the agreed SLA. Can Redwood confirm an escalation ladder and a named on-call contact (or rota) for the duration of the contract?
2) Monthly reporting: yes to monthly uptime reports — we also need token-level request logs for a 30 day rolling window (redacted as needed) for troubleshooting.

We can accept the capped credit ladder up to 50% and the adjusted P1 times if the above two items are added. If possible, attach SOC2 attestation for the last 12 months or provide a link to the SOC2 report in Drive.

We are OK to move to consolidated redline and a DocuSign stage once we have those items confirmed.

Samir
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Rao <samir@helixpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: HelixPay redlines to MSA/order form — SLA ask

Samir — good news, we can accommodate both asks with the following binds we will put into the redline: 

- Escalation playbook: we will include an Appendix D (Escalation & Oncall) that references a 24/7 P1 on-call rotation, an escalation ladder (SRE -> Ops Manager -> VP of Infra) and a commitment to provide a named on-call contact for each incident within 1 hour of P1 ack. Names/rotas will be provided to HelixPay on contract signature and kept current.
- Monthly reporting & logs: Redwood will provide a monthly uptime report and token-level request logs for a 30-day rolling window via a secure link. Logs will be made available in redacted form to protect other customers; for deeper forensics we will support a joint post-incident review.

Action items and timeline:
- Marissa to finalize consolidated redline and appendices by EOD Monday (11/29).
- Jonas to confirm the exact log retention/export format and any redaction rules by 11/29.
- Mina to schedule a 30-minute review call with Samir/Elena for 11/30 — will send calendar invite once times confirmed.

DocuSign & next steps: once the consolidated redline is accepted we will upload to DocuSign (pre-sign stage) and provide a HubSpot update: HLX-2026-042.

Attachments: consolidated_orderform_draft.docx (to be updated with final redline)

Appreciate the collaboration — we'll prioritize to meet your procurement dates.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
